title: X402, a static blog monetization excercise
summary: This article documents a proof-of-concept implementation of X402, a payment protocol that enables direct monetization for static blog content without requiring traditional ads or subscriptions, exploring how bloggers can receive payments on a per-article or per-read basis.
problem_solved: Provides a frictionless payment mechanism for static blog content creators to monetize their work directly without relying on advertising or complex subscription systems.
why_valuable: Enables independent content creators to earn money directly from readers through micro-payments, potentially revolutionizing how static content is monetized on the open web.
